_meta.description: Canonical Gameplay Architecture V2 ability definitions for every monster ability type referenced by data/definitions/monsters/monsters.json. Each ability resolves to one or more canonical Actions from data/definitions/actions.json. Monsters reference these by ability id; the monster-level ability_cooldown_ticks controls cast cadence, not the payload.
_meta.architecture: Source (monster) -> Policy (spell_frequency, ability_cooldown_ticks, range, saving throw) -> Actions (this file) -> Statuses (data/definitions/statuses.json)
_meta.level_variable: All monster-scaled formulas use 'rlev', the monster's native depth/level (matches MAngband rlev = max(native depth, 1)), resolved by the runtime at cast time.

amount_kinds.monster_level_formula: New kind proposed by this file. Fixed dice plus a level-scaled additive bonus: total = roll(base_dice) + flat_base + floor(rlev * level_multiplier) or floor(rlev / level_divisor). Fields: base_dice { count, sides } (optional), flat_base (optional, default 0), level_multiplier (optional, decimal), level_divisor (optional, integer; use instead of level_multiplier when the MAngband formula is an exact fraction such as rlev/3).
amount_kinds.monster_level_scaled_dice: New kind proposed by this file. The dice shape itself scales with monster level, matching formulas like 1d(rlev*3)+15 or (1+rlev/7)d12. Fields: count (optional base count, default 1), count_level_divisor (optional, adds floor(rlev / divisor) to count), sides (optional base sides), sides_level_multiplier (optional decimal, sides = floor(rlev * multiplier)), sides_level_divisor (optional integer, sides = floor(rlev / divisor)), flat_bonus (optional, added after the roll).
amount_kinds.monster_hp_fraction: New kind proposed by this file. Matches MAngband breath damage: total = min(floor(current_hp / divisor), max). Fields: divisor, max.
amount_kinds.future_reuse_note: These three kinds are intentionally caster-agnostic in shape. A future 'caster_level_formula' kind for player spells (base + level_multiplier against caster level instead of rlev) can reuse the same {base_dice/base, level_multiplier/level_divisor} fields with a different level_variable binding.

unresolved_parity_questions: haste_self: MAngband HASTE targets the caster itself, but ModifyMonsterSpeed.target_mode only allows aimed/all_in_los. Proposing a new 'self' target_mode value.

drain_mana: MAngband DRAIN_MANA drains the player's mana pool and heals the caster for 6x the amount drained. No existing action models a targeted resource drain with a linked caster heal. Proposing a new DrainResource action.
shriek: SHRIEK aggravates every monster on the level. AggravateMonsters exists but its allowed_source_families does not include monster_ability. Proposing that extension.
forget: MAngband FORGET erases the player's item/map knowledge. No existing action models knowledge loss. Proposing a new ForgetKnowledge action.
bolt_ice, bolt_water, ball_water: no 'ice' or 'water' damage_type exists on BoltDamage/BallDamage. Approximated as cold (ice) and physical (water) with provenance_status unresolved.
bolt_plasma, breath_plasma: no 'plasma' damage_type exists on any projectile/breath action. Approximated as fire with provenance_status unresolved.
breath_light: BreathDamage has no 'light' channel (only Bolt/BallDamage do). Modeled via BallDamage as a radius substitute; breath attenuation/direction semantics are not preserved.
breath_confusion: BreathDamage has no 'confusion' channel. Modeled as ApplyStatus(confused) only; the MAngband hp/6-cap400 damage component is not represented.
breath_inertia: BreathDamage has no 'inertia' channel. Modeled as ModifyMonsterSpeed(slow) only; the MAngband hp/6-cap200 damage component is not represented.

breath_gravity, breath_time, breath_wall: no matching damage_type exists on BreathDamage for gravity, time, or force/wall channels. Left as high-level placeholders using the nearest exotic channel (nexus/chaos) with provenance_status unresolved pending a catalog decision; do not treat as verified.
summon_kin, summon_hydra, summon_angel, summon_wraith: SummonEntities.summon_family has no kin/hydra/angel/wraith value. Approximated with the nearest existing family and flagged unresolved.

summon_hi_undead, summon_hi_dragon, summon_hi_demon: SummonEntities has no tier concept to distinguish 'greater' summons from their base family. Proposing an optional 'tier' parameter (normal|greater).
cause_4 bleed component: MAngband CAUSE_4 adds 10d10 cut/bleed damage. No 'cut' or 'bleeding' status exists in statuses.json, so only the direct damage action is modeled.

mind_blast / brain_smash secondary statuses: modeled with the best-fit existing statuses (confused, blinded, paralyzed) plus ModifyMonsterSpeed(slow) for brain_smash; exact MAngband save-per-effect semantics are policy-layer concerns not modeled here.

abilities.name: Darkness ball
abilities.notes: Distinct from the 'darkness' ability: this deals dark damage, 'darkness' only unlights an area.

abilities.name: Water ball
abilities.notes: No 'water' damage_type exists on BallDamage. Approximated as physical pending a catalog decision.

abilities.name: Blind
abilities.source_formula: MAngband BLIND: 12+d4 turns, resisted by resist_blind or saving throw

abilities.name: Ice bolt
abilities.notes: No distinct 'ice' damage_type exists on BoltDamage. Approximated as cold.

abilities.name: Plasma bolt
abilities.notes: No 'plasma' damage_type exists on BoltDamage. Approximated as fire pending a catalog decision.

abilities.name: Water bolt
abilities.notes: No 'water' damage_type exists on BoltDamage. Approximated as physical.

abilities.name: Brain smash
abilities.source_formula: MAngband BRAIN_SMASH: 12d15 mental damage + blind + confuse + paralyze + slow
abilities.notes: Secondary statuses are best-fit approximations of the MAngband composite effect; exact per-effect save semantics are a policy-layer concern.

abilities.name: Breathe confusion
abilities.notes: BreathDamage has no 'confusion' channel. Modeled as a direct confusion status only; the damage component is not represented.

abilities.name: Breathe gravity
abilities.notes: No 'gravity' damage_type exists on BreathDamage. Approximated as chaos pending a catalog decision; MAngband gravity breath also stuns and knocks back, which are not represented.

abilities.name: Breathe inertia
abilities.notes: BreathDamage has no 'inertia' channel. Modeled as a slow effect only; the damage component is not represented.

abilities.name: Breathe light
abilities.notes: BreathDamage has no 'light' channel (only Bolt/BallDamage do). Modeled via BallDamage as a radius substitute; directional breath attenuation is not preserved.

abilities.name: Breathe plasma
abilities.notes: No 'plasma' damage_type exists on BreathDamage. Approximated as fire pending a catalog decision.

abilities.name: Breathe time
abilities.notes: No 'time' damage_type exists on BreathDamage. Approximated as nexus (both are reality-distortion channels) pending a catalog decision; MAngband time breath also drains a stat, which is not represented.

abilities.name: Breathe force
abilities.notes: No 'force' damage_type exists on BreathDamage, and the terrain-destruction semantics of GF_KILL_WALL are not represented by any damage action. Deferred per docs/gameplay/implementation/MONSTER_SPELL_ABILITY_MIGRATION_ANALYSIS.md Category D; approximated as chaos.

abilities.name: Cause critical wounds
abilities.notes: The bleeding/cut component is not modeled: no 'cut' or 'bleeding' status exists in statuses.json.

abilities.name: Confuse
abilities.source_formula: MAngband CONF: 4+d4 turns, resisted by resist_conf or saving throw

abilities.name: Darkness
abilities.notes: Distinct from 'ball_darkness', which deals dark damage; this only removes light.

abilities.name: Drain mana
abilities.source_formula: MAngband DRAIN_MANA: 1d(rlev/2)+1 mana drained from target, caster heals 6x the amount drained
abilities.notes: No existing action models a targeted resource drain linked to a caster heal. Proposing a new DrainResource action; ModifyResourceMeter only models self-adjustment, not a target-to-caster transfer.

abilities.name: Forget
abilities.source_formula: MAngband FORGET: erases the player's item and map knowledge, resisted by saving throw
abilities.notes: No existing action models knowledge loss. Proposing a new ForgetKnowledge action; not yet added to actions.json.

abilities.name: Haste self
abilities.source_formula: MAngband HASTE: caster gains +10 speed (up to base+10 quickly, then +2 up to base+20)
abilities.notes: ModifyMonsterSpeed.target_mode has no 'self' value; the caster is always the intended target. Proposing a new 'self' target_mode value.

abilities.name: Heal self
abilities.source_formula: MAngband HEAL: recovers rlev*6 HP, cancels fear

abilities.name: Hold
abilities.source_formula: MAngband HOLD: 4+d4 turns, resisted by free_act or saving throw

abilities.name: Mind blast
abilities.source_formula: MAngband MIND_BLAST: 8d8 + confusion if not resist_conf

abilities.name: Scare
abilities.source_formula: MAngband SCARE: 4+d4 turns, resisted by resist_fear or saving throw

abilities.name: Shriek
abilities.source_formula: MAngband SHRIEK: 0 damage, aggravates all monsters on the level
abilities.notes: AggravateMonsters exists and matches the semantics, but its allowed_source_families does not include monster_ability. Proposing that extension.

abilities.name: Slow
abilities.source_formula: MAngband SLOW: 4+d4 turns, resisted by free_act or saving throw

abilities.name: Summon kin
abilities.source_formula: MAngband S_KIN: summons 6 monsters sharing the caster's symbol

abilities.name: Teleport away
abilities.source_formula: MAngband TELE_AWAY: teleports the player away, range ~100

abilities.name: Teleport level
abilities.source_formula: MAngband TELE_LEVEL: sends the player up or down one dungeon level, resisted by resist_nexus or saving throw

abilities.name: Teleport to
abilities.source_formula: MAngband TELE_TO: teleports the player adjacent to the caster
abilities.notes: TeleportTarget.distance is set to 0 to mean 'adjacent to caster', a policy-defined interpretation rather than a free-range relocation.

abilities.name: Create traps
abilities.source_formula: MAngband TRAPS: creates traps on empty floor squares around the player
